newsitem.title: USA: Triton Energy has votes to make changes.
newsitem.headline: Triton Energy has votes to make changes.

text.p: Triton Energy Ltd said it has received sufficient tenders and consents from holders of Triton Energy Corp's outstanding senior subordinated discount notes due 1997 and 9-3/4 percent senior subordinated discount notes due 2000 to make proposed amendments to the notes' indentures.

On April 3, Triton announced a cash tender offer and consent solicitation relating to these issues, saying it was seeking to "eliminate substantially all of the restrictive convenants contained" in the indentures.

Under the terms of the offer distributed by Triton Energy Ltd and its Triton Energy Corp subsidiary, holders of both notes have until 2359 EDT April 18/0359 GMT April 19 to tender their notes and the related consents and receive a consent payment of $5.00 per $1,000 principal amount of notes.
The tender offer is still scheduled to expire at 2359 EDT May 1/0359 GMT May 2 with the price to be paid for the notes tendered to be set at 1400 EDT/1800 GMT April 28.
